purpose: Test whether omitted source families would have surfaced non-tech weekly candidates under unchanged V1.9-style selection discipline.

sourceBiasCases.reason: This is a real healthcare regime change omitted from old discovery, but policy support alone does not isolate a specific A-share product/earnings bridge. It demonstrates source-coverage bias, not an automatic stock pick.

sourceBiasCases.reason: This is a potentially important capital-flow/rerating event absent from the old discovery universe, but the current Skill has no dedicated market-structure expression route and therefore cannot map it cleanly through company earnings.
